assessments.reasoning: The specification’s Filter algebra includes the mapping only when the expression’s final effective boolean value is true and assigns its input multiplicity to an included mapping. The enclosing expression rules eliminate false or error outcomes at this operator.

challenge.method: Check a mapping repeated twice with true, false and error outcomes. Compare an error under true OR against an unmasked type error. Inspect the linked Filter notation erratum and the dataset-sensitive EXISTS context.
challenge.results: Final true yields two copies. False and final error yield none. A logical OR can give a true final value even when one branch errors. The linked erratum concerns the formal placement of dataset notation rather than a change to the final-value or surviving-cardinality rules.

limitations: The result concerns this operator and its final expression outcome. The active graph can affect expression evaluation, and separate optional or later query operators can alter the overall result.
